fact: The Ministry of Health states that SIS/Portal and DHIS2 have been implemented in recent years, but decentralised evolution has left limits on interoperability, redundant data flows and inconsistent data, so it commissions a review of the national health information system architecture.
title: Termos de Referência (TdR) Consultor Nacional para Revisão da Arquitetura do Sistema de Informação em Saúde e Planeamento
publisher: Ministério da Saúde de Cabo Verde
